lessons_used: No kind of change has proven helpful yet, as no test produced a statistically significant win.
Adding new finish screens (finish, new_screen) harms performance, with 3 tests agreeing after noise correction (-3.4% overall).
Reordering sign-in (sign_in, reorder) harms performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-2.3% overall).
New adoption flows (adoption, new_flow) harm performance, with 2 tests agreeing after noise correction (-1.7% overall).
Evidence is thin or inconsistent for new home flows, adoption redesigns, and path selection redesigns, with no clear effect seen.
Predictions were consistently overly optimistic compared to measured results.

candidates.title: Path Choice Compact List Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the choose_path screen layout to a compact list layout with quick path comparison text.
candidates.why: Path selection stage has a long mean duration of 514s, indicating decision paralysis when choosing a pet adoption path.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet Path
choose_path.body: Select standard adoption to pick a pre-made friend or create a custom pet.

guard.reason: Valid layout redesign for choose_path that maintains both adoption paths.

candidates.score_note: choose_path redesigns historically showed -0.1% lift across 4 prior tests.

candidates.title: Story Screen Mascot Welcome Intro
candidates.change: Insert a new introductory mascot welcome screen right before the story screen to set expectations.
candidates.why: First-run users spend mean 514s on the first step, suggesting a clearer initial context can help ground the onboarding experience.

new_mascot_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Friend
new_mascot_intro.body: Welcome! Let's get your desktop pet configured in a few simple steps.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a new introductory screen within the onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Adding new screens consistently harms onboarding performance (-3.4% overall).

candidates.why: Support received 3 emails asking how to control, hide, or talk to pets after setup, and finish step conversion is low at 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: How to Interact with Your Pet
home_intro.body: Learn how to access desktop hotkeys, summon your pet, or minimize it to your taskbar.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of home_intro within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: High support volume and drop-off rate, but redesigns have not proven effective.

pick_friend.hint: Browse available pets and select the character that best matches your desk vibe.

sign_in.hint: Your saved pets will automatically load after authentication.

guard.reason: Valid copy update for sign_in screen explaining account preservation.

candidates.score_note: Addresses the largest support complaint category (8 emails) via a low-risk text update.

candidates.why: Support received 3 emails about pets not appearing on desktop after setup, and home waiting screen has a high mean duration (2336s).

waiting.hint: Once setup finishes, your companion will appear in your system tray and walk onto your screen.

candidates.score_note: Solves 3 support emails about desktop tray visibility with low-cost hint text.

candidates.score_note: Addresses extreme mean waiting duration (2336s) by notifying users when pet is ready.
